answer: Priced burn-bond gating makes every newcomer post a locked bond and solve a device-keyed proof-of-work before any payout; the bond is slashed if its first five attestations fail, and only a quorum signal unlocks the trust thread. A fabricated fable of prior work cannot bypass the keyed puzzle. At $8 and two minutes per attempt, a 500-identity ring spends $4,000 and 17 hours before one cent is earned, while correlated slashes and a per-hour cap make the ring's expected return negative.
